evidence_items.explanation: The February report records 42 solved tasks out of 50 formalized benchmark tasks, an 84% success rate, while documenting broad language exclusions. It identifies inequalities and variable numbers of points as uncovered, with Section 2 also identifying three-dimensional geometry and nonlinear equations among uncovered benchmark content.
